name: rednote-desktop
description: 小红薯桌面端 - Electron + React + TypeScript

scripts.build:native: cmake -S native -B native/build -G "Visual Studio 18 2026" -A x64 && cmake --build native/build --config Release
scripts.dev: npm run build:main && concurrently -k "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5174 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5174 electron ."
scripts.build: npm run build:main && tsc --noEmit && vite build
